Report on the committee's review of the Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)

Report number: M20/R/EC/2026/02
12 August 2026

Environment and Climate Change Committee

Under Article 130 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, the responsibility of this committee is to look into and study all matters relating to the environment and climate change and take the necessary measures, and to oversee the work of the ministry responsible for climate change, environment and energy policy, the Environmental Protection Agency, the Maldives Meteorological Service, the Utility Regulatory Authority and other offices related to climate change and the environment. In addition to advising those offices as the committee sees fit regarding their work, it is also to study the various reports compiled and published by those offices and advise the relevant offices on the measures the committee considers should be taken in connection with those reports.

In addition, studying bills submitted to the Majlis on all matters relating to the environment and climate change, studying the annual reports of the ministry responsible for environmental policy, and overseeing the extent to which laws passed relating to the environment and climate change are being implemented are also responsibilities of this committee.

1. Introduction

This is the report on how this committee reviewed and concluded the "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)", submitted on behalf of the government, following its referral to this committee for review at the 18th sitting of the second session of the People's Majlis for 2026, held on 3 August 2026.

The "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)" was submitted to the People's Majlis on behalf of the government by Hassan Waheed, member for Vilifushi constituency. The first reading of the bill was read out and the preliminary debate on the bill began at the 17th sitting of the second session of the People's Majlis for 2026, held on 29 July 2026. After that, the preliminary debate on the bill continued at the 18th sitting of the second session of the People's Majlis for 2026, held on 3 August 2026, and the bill was accepted by the Majlis with the unanimous agreement of the 56 (fifty-six) members present at that sitting and taking part in the vote.

The stated reason for submitting the bill notes that the "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)" is a bill submitted on behalf of the government to bring the amendments needed to that law in order to strengthen the administrative management of the Utility Regulatory Authority established under that law.

2. How the committee reviewed the bill

Following the referral of the "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)" to the committee, at this committee's 9th meeting of 2026, held on 05 August 2026, the committee members discussed how to proceed with the work on this bill, and the committee decided that the deadline for the committee to complete its work on this bill would be 16 September 2026. At that meeting, in addition to opening an opportunity for the public to submit views on the bill until 10 August 2026, the committee also decided to send a letter to the Ministry of Climate Change,

[signature] [stamp]

Environment and Energy requesting, in writing, any amendments the ministry wished to propose to the bill.

However, no party submitted any views during the opportunity opened for submitting views on this bill. The Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Energy also replied to this committee in writing that the ministry had no comments on this bill.

In reviewing this bill, the committee took into account the points noted by committee members and the views expressed by members of the People's Majlis at Majlis sittings regarding this bill. A total of 2 committee meetings were held to review this bill. At those meetings, committee members spent approximately 1 hour and 36 minutes reviewing this bill.

3. Decision

After reviewing the "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)" and discussing it among the committee members, the committee decided, at this committee's 12th meeting of 2026, held on 11 August 2026, with the unanimous agreement of the members present at the committee at that time and taking part in the vote, to pass this bill without any amendment, in the form in which it was submitted to the People's Majlis on behalf of the government.

Therefore, we submit with this report, under Article 130 (i) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, the "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)", submitted on behalf of the government by Hassan Waheed, member for Vilifushi constituency, and passed by the committee, requesting the People's Majlis to decide on it as it sees fit.

The "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)" as passed by the committee is attached as "Schedule 1" of this report.

[signature] [stamp]

In addition, details of members' attendance at the committee meetings held to review the "Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)" are attached as "Schedule 2" of this report.

Bill on the ... Amendment to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act)

The following amendments are made to Law No. 26/2020 (Utility Regulatory Authority Act).

1. Amending Article 4 (t) of the said Law as follows.

4. (t) To carry out all matters that the Authority is required to do under this Law, or under a specific law relating to public utility services, or under any other law, and to arrange other matters relating to the provision of public utility services, in accordance with this Law and the specific laws relating to public utility services or other relevant laws.

2. Amending Article 6 (b) of the said Law as follows.

6. (b) The Board shall consist of 7 (seven) members, including the Chief Executive of the Authority, who is appointed to the Board by virtue of office.

3. Amending the opening phrase of Article 7 (a) of the said Law as follows.

7. (a) Apart from the Chief Executive of the Authority, those appointed to the Board as members of the Authority's Board of Directors shall be, from among persons with technical education and experience in the following fields,

[Word tracked-change margin notes beside 6.(ށ) and 7.(ހ): "Deleted: ް"]
[signature] [stamp]

1 (one) member from each of those fields.

4. Adding a number after number (5) of Article 7 (a) of the said Law as follows.

7. (a) (6) The legal field.

5. Amending Article 7 (c) of the said Law as follows.

7. (c) Apart from the Chief Executive of the Authority, each member appointed as a member of the Board under this Article shall be appointed for a term of 5 (five) years.

6. Adding a subsection after Article 7 (c) of the said Law as follows.

7. (d) Notwithstanding what is stated in subsection (c) of this Article, every member, other than members removed from Board membership under Article 9 of this Law, may be appointed as a Board member for more than one term.

7. Amending Article 8 (a) of the said Law as follows.

8. (a) The President shall appoint a member from among the Board members, other than the Chief Executive of the Authority, to the post of Chairperson of the Board of Directors.

8. Amending Article 13 (b) of the said Law as follows.

13. (b) A meeting of the Board may be held only when members equal in number to a majority of the total members of the Board, including the Chairperson of the Board,

[Word tracked-change margin notes beside 7.(ނ) and 8.(ހ): "Deleted: ް", "Deleted:"]
[signature] [stamp]

are present.

9. Amending Article 13 (d) of the said Law as follows.

13. (d) If a number of members equal to a majority of the total members of the Board wish to hold a meeting of the Board, they may submit this to the Chairperson of the Board, stating the reason. The Chairperson of the Board shall then hold a meeting of the Board, as proposed in that notice, within 5 (five) days of receiving that notice.

10. Adding a subsection after Article 13 (e) of the said Law as follows.

13. (f) The Chief Executive shall not have the right to vote on any matter decided by the Board.

11. Following the amendment made to Article 7 (a) of the said Law by Article 4 of this Law, the additional member to be appointed to the Authority's Board of Directors shall be appointed within 30 (thirty) days of this Law coming into force.

12. This Law shall come into force from the day it is passed, ratified and published in the Government Gazette of the Maldives.
